citations.relevance: Discusses sensation fiction’s gendered dynamics and Robert Audley’s movement from idle, amused observer to active moral investigator in relation to Lady Audley.

citations.author: Showalter, Elaine
citations.title: A Jury of Her Peers: Victorian Sensation Novels
citations.relevance: Reads Lady Audley’s Secret as a key sensation novel in which male scrutiny hardens into judgment, illuminating Robert Audley’s increasingly hostile stance toward Lady Audley.

citations.author: Miller, D. A.
citations.title: The Novel and the Police
citations.relevance: Although broader than Braddon alone, it is frequently used to explain how Robert Audley’s pursuit of Lady Audley shifts from social fascination to disciplinary surveillance and accusation.
